findings.issue:
Exp A design v2 delta is not implemented. docs/EXPA_DESIGN_V2_DELTA.md says it applies after the build workflow. The code is still v1 throughout:
- salts expA-v1 and expA-omit-v1, the parity-based indirect enrichment, and the A/Q split
- variant name 'complete', not 'vcomplete'
- v1 task-adapted wording, with no per-item A/B pair assignment
- C4/triggered rendered as its own cell
- v1 prompt template
- function-level omitted_recovered
- no site spans or kinds in truth (D2)
- no runtime-witness, no-truncation or incidental-visibility eligibility filters (D3)
- strata limited to direct/indirect
- no t-interval in the analysis (D9)
findings.recommended_fix: The coordinator applies D1-D9 as a separate change set before the prereg freeze. It touches truth, items, render, wording, harness, score and analysis. analysis.item_from_record and STRATA will reject the v2 strata alias, callback and dynamic.

findings.issue: The controller env has no matplotlib, so scripts/expA_figures.py fails there with ModuleNotFoundError. The design expects one command to regenerate ANALYSIS.json, TABLES.md and the figures. The CommandTests figure branch is silently skipped under the controller env (HAS_MATPLOTLIB is False). With matplotlib 3.9.2 in a separate env the figures and the analysis tests (29/29) work.
findings.recommended_fix: Coordinator decision: install a pinned matplotlib==3.9.2 into the analysis env (the analysis lane's figures recorded 3.9.2), or document a dedicated figures env and run the figure tests there.

findings.issue: Shared code side effect, confirmed: graphs.GraphBackend.build runs its worker with an environment that lacks PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE. After the static engine tests I observed absent_edges/__pycache__/{__init__,data,graphs}.cpython-311.pyc written into dev/integrate/src, even though the tests ran with PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1.
findings.recommended_fix: Run backend L from a read-only releases/<sha>/ tree, have the release audit tolerate __pycache__, or change graphs.py with approval. graphs.py is outside the probe package, so it was not modified.

findings.issue: The dev trace runs (trace-1 to trace-4) staged an older identity.py, 652f88f5, according to plugin_files in the trace manifest. The static outputs and items use 6eb3410b. The tracer lane reports 0 identity mismatches, but production traces must not mix versions.
findings.recommended_fix: Launch production traces only from the frozen release copy, and check that every trace manifest's plugin_files identity.py sha256 equals the release's identity.py before building items.

findings.issue: No tool derives the item build spec from the registry. Families, roles, package_dirs, commits, static_dir and trace_dir would have to be assembled by hand for 30+ families. The items lane's own spec referenced dev/static/smoke/<family>, which no longer exists; with this integration that spec would now fail loudly instead of silently.
findings.recommended_fix: Add a small 'spec' subcommand that reads the registry (role main/dev, status ok) and writes the spec with static_dir and trace_dir per family and the full main_roster. It should cross-check registry commits against the static and trace manifests.

findings.issue: Stale documentation: the analysis docstring says score.py leaves omitted_recovered null outside the omission variants. score.py actually reports it for every variant, including C0 and complete; the derived count was 0 in the e2e check. The behaviour is correct; only the comment is wrong.
findings.recommended_fix: Update the docstring and comment (lines 60 and 866) when analysis.py is next edited.

findings.issue: items.natural_false_positives is computed as natural callers minus V. It therefore also contains real recursive self-calls and unverified single-backend (U) callers, so the name overstates what it holds. Separately, truth.stratum labels a verified caller direct if any verifying-source line (including fuzzy LocAgent lines) contains 'name('.
findings.recommended_fix: Report it as 'natural_not_verified' in the paper and analysis. v2 D2 replaces line heuristics with AST site kinds.

findings.issue: C4/always payloads exceed the 12,000-byte render cap (up to 12,958 bytes) because the verification block is appended after rendering. This follows the design, and all dry-run prompts fit the 16,384-token budget (largest first prompt + 4,096 = 8,670 tokens). It should still be stated in the prereg.
findings.recommended_fix: State in the prereg that the cap applies to the C1-C3 graph answer and that C4 adds at most 2,000 bytes of lexical block.

fixed: Missing score glue: no command turned score.score_run rows into the --scores JSONL that expA_analyze.py requires for every Submitted harness result. Added scripts/expA_score.py: it checks each checkout's package tree against the items, writes rows that are never overwritten, and prints a summary with input and output hashes. Test added: tests/test_probe_score.py::test_cli_rows_are_the_analysis_scores_input. Verified on the 105-cell harness e2e run through to analysis.

Silent trace drop in absent_edges/probe/items.py family_inputs_from_spec: a spec trace_dir that did not exist was quietly treated as 'no trace input' (status unavailable), silently removing every trace-only verified caller from V. A named static_dir or trace_dir that is not a directory now raises ValueError. Test added: tests/test_probe_items.py::test_missing_trace_dir_and_foreign_trace_tree_are_rejected.

Unchecked trace source tree in absent_edges/probe/items.py build_family: the static manifests' source_tree_sha256 was enforced, but the trace manifest's repo.source_tree.sha256 was only recorded. Trace lines from a different tree would have been mapped to the wrong functions. The build now raises ValueError on a mismatch when trace records are used. Same test as above.

C4 contract not checked in scripts/expA_run.py: render C4 blocks and the live source_reference_search share tools.lexical_search, but nothing checked that the items' C4 blocks used the live tool's token bound (Runner builds ToolBox with no counter, so the UTF-8 byte bound) or matched the source. Added check_c4_search_contract, called in build_cells for C4 arms after the payload lookup, so the existing missing-payload error is unchanged. Test added: tests/test_probe_harness.py::RunnerTests::test_c4_cells_need_the_live_search_contract.

INTERFACE NOTES FOR OTHER LANES AND THE COORDINATOR:
1. New `scripts/expA_score.py --run-dir RUN --items items.jsonl (--repos-root R | --checkouts JSON) --out scores.jsonl`. It writes score.score_run rows as canonical JSONL and never overwrites. It refuses a checkout whose package tree differs from the items' render.source_sha256. Its output is the `--scores` input of expA_analyze.py.
2. items.load_build_spec now raises if a named static_dir or trace_dir does not exist. To mark a trace as unavailable, omit trace_dir or point it at a run whose manifest says unavailable.
3. The item build now aborts if the trace manifest's repo.source_tree.sha256 differs from the package tree (when trace records are used).
4. expA_run (both dry and live) refuses C4 cells unless the item's verification.token_bound is utf8_bytes_upper_bound and its C4 block matches the source with no error. If the live tool ever gets an exact token counter, Runner.setup's ToolBox, check_c4_search_contract and the item build must all change together.
5. No tool builds the item build spec from the registry yet. Mapping: role → class; static_dir = <static>/<family>; trace_dir = <traces>/<family>; main_roster must list every main family. The items lane's spec pointed at dev/static/smoke, which no longer exists. Their numbers (J 543, 696 payloads) come from older static outputs; the final outputs give J 545 and 690 payloads.
